test.create_query: CREATE TABLE row_wrapper_lookups ( id UInt64, u1 UInt32, u2 UInt32, u3 UInt32, u4 UInt32, u5 UInt32, u6 UInt32, u7 UInt32, u8 UInt32, u9 UInt32, u10 UInt32, s1 String, s2 String, s3 String, s4 String, s5 String, s6 String, s7 String, s8 String, s9 String, s10 String, bundle Row( u1 UInt32, u2 UInt32, u3 UInt32, u4 UInt32, u5 UInt32, u6 UInt32, u7 UInt32, u8 UInt32, u9 UInt32, u10 UInt32, s1 String, s2 String, s3 String, s4 String, s5 String, s6 String, s7 String, s8 String, s9 String, s10 String) MATERIALIZED tuple(u1, u2, u3, u4, u5, u6, u7, u8, u9, u10, s1, s2, s3, s4, s5, s6, s7, s8, s9, s10) ) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id SETTINGS index_granularity = 128, min_bytes_for_wide_part = 0, allow_experimental_row_type = 1
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO row_wrapper_lookups SELECT number, intHash32(number + 1) % 100000, intHash32(number + 2) % 100000, intHash32(number + 3) % 100000, intHash32(number + 4) % 100000, intHash32(number + 5) % 100000, intHash32(number + 6) % 100000, intHash32(number + 7) % 100000, intHash32(number + 8) % 100000, intHash32(number + 9) % 100000, intHash32(number + 10) % 100000, concat('v', toString(intHash32(number * 1) % 100000)), concat('v', toString(intHash32(number * 2) % 100000)), concat('v', toString(intHash32(number * 3) % 100000)), concat('v', toString(intHash32(number * 4) % 100000)), concat('v', toString(intHash32(number * 5) % 100000)), concat('v', toString(intHash32(number * 6) % 100000)), concat('v', toString(intHash32(number * 7) % 100000)), concat('v', toString(intHash32(number * 8) % 100000)), concat('v', toString(intHash32(number * 9) % 100000)), concat('v', toString(intHash32(number * 10) % 100000)) FROM numbers_mt(5000000)
test.query: SELECT u1, u2, u3, u4, u5, u6, u7, u8, u9, u10, s1, s2, s3, s4, s5, s6, s7, s8, s9, s10 FROM row_wrapper_lookups WHERE id IN (SELECT number * 12503 FROM numbers(400)) FORMAT Null SETTINGS query_plan_use_row_wrappers = {wrappers}
SELECT u1, s1, u5 FROM row_wrapper_lookups WHERE id IN (SELECT number * 12503 FROM numbers(400)) FORMAT Null SETTINGS query_plan_use_row_wrappers = {wrappers}

SELECT u1, u2, u3, u4, u5, u6, u7, u8, u9, u10, s1, s2, s3, s4, s5, s6, s7, s8, s9, s10 FROM row_wrapper_lookups ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 100000 FORMAT Null SETTINGS query_plan_use_row_wrappers = {wrappers}
